overall_limitations: Several composite rubric items are distributed across separate claims. Gold credit here requires an individual claim to adequately state the complete item; complementary fragments are not combined.
The claims omit several explicit consequences and controls, including power-loss rollback, checkpoint-induced commit latency, the default 1000-page threshold, and automatic PASSIVE mode.
The supplied packet does not establish the inventory-dependent novelty judgments or numerical concept-selection scores.
